units.analyst_summary: The ruler who holds the whole (大體) lets law be the mirror: 不躬不親，庶事敢陳 — do not micromanage; positions, names, and consequences do the governing. The sage-king seems idle because the system carries the load.
principles: govern through structure, not personal intervention
a system that needs the ruler awake is a weak system
reserve personal action for the irreversible
units.fang_yuan_anchor: External-system doctrine: the 0.5B actor stays small because the surrounding system (DB, simulator, retriever) carries the load.

units.analyst_summary: Observe behavior, not claims: 古人所難者非一己之才能，乃知人之明. Use mirrors and levels (度量) to read others; self-knowledge requires the same instruments pointed inward.
principles: behavior is the only testimony
measurement replaces intuition
turn the assessment tools on yourself
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Reality recognition: allies rated per data point (the commitment-failure lesson) and the benchmark-first philosophy applied to the model itself.

units.analyst_summary: Unnecessary punishments breed resentment; unpredictable rewards breed scheming. 用人: assign within capability, make consequences lawful and legible, and never let subordinates' duties outrun their information.
principles: consequences must be legible to shape behavior
duties outrun information at your peril
match assignment to capability, not hope
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Delegation-by-failure-mode doctrine: execute-critical information rides with the task; identity information stays central.

units.analyst_summary: Rulers fail by loving tradition (法古) or by loving change for its own sake (變古); the test is results in the present. Supporters of the status quo and champions of novelty both argue feelings; the ruler argues outcomes.
principles: arguments from tradition or novelty both dodge the outcome test
pilot, measure, then scale
yesterday's success is not evidence
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Iteration discipline: the simulator decides which methods survive — never tradition, never fashion.

units.analyst_summary: Case collection: the man waiting under the tree (守株待兔) mistakes one luck for a system; the painter who prefers ghosts over dogs (no one can verify ghosts); promises priced by their verifiability.
principles: one success is an anecdote; systems repeat
prefer verifiable work to unfalsifiable display
promise exactly what can be checked
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Fake-quote discipline and the benchmark's anti-gaming design: unfalsifiable claims get flagged, verifiable records get trusted.

units.analyst_summary: Li Guang: beloved general, superb personal warrior, chronically unlucky in system terms — no records discipline, no supply planning, inconsistent scouting. Sima Qian's sympathy cannot hide the lesson: courage without accounting loses to planning without flair (Wei Qing/Huo Qubing logistics).
principles: charisma is not a supply chain
records and scouting are the boring decisive layer
personal bravery does not compound; preparation does
units.fang_yuan_anchor: The prepared-opportunist doctrine: Fang Yuan's legendary moves are the visible ends of long preparation chains.

units.page: 戰國策 (士禮居叢書本)/秦/三
units.analyst_summary: 范雎說秦王: remote-claim jump strategy (遠交近攻) — ally the far, take the near; consolidated gains beat dispersed glory. Also the danger of speaking past the listener's fear and the patience of building credibility before the great proposal.
principles: consolidate near gains before far adventures
sequence the map: who is reachable now
credibility is built in small hearings before the grand one
units.fang_yuan_anchor: Sequencing doctrine: Fang Yuan consolidates each region's gains before the next horizon (Shang city capital → Northern Plains position → Central Continent).
